correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the established all-zonotope wedge-volume theorem, verifies the cycle forest Gram determinant by tridiagonal recurrence, counts rooted cyclic compositions correctly, then obtains an exact logarithmic coefficient identity. Positivity and two consecutive powers isolate a simple singularity; uniform complex perturbation yields exponential moment-generating errors and correct first two derivatives. Characteristic functions prove the Gaussian limit for every fixed positive weight. Independent program tests computed all proper subsets through order 11 and analytic coefficients through order 150. Finite tests are explicitly not an infinite proof.
